## Figure Description: Layer-wise Mechanism of RSP

**1. Overall Layout:**
The figure will be presented on a pure white background, maintaining a clean and schematic aesthetic suitable for a scientific publication. The central and most prominent feature, occupying approximately 70% of the total figure area, will be the **Main Energy Landscape Panel**. This panel will be flanked by three smaller, supporting inset panels:
- A **Decomposition Inset** positioned in the top-right corner.
- An **Annealing Schedule Inset** located in the bottom-right corner.
- A **Minimax Annotation** text box situated in the top-left corner.
The overall flow within the main panel implicitly progresses from top to bottom (or front to back in the 3D perspective) as the layer index increases.
